name: Fontina Bonifaz
original_name: フォンティナ・ボニファッツ
source: As the only songstress in the Roquefort company with enough skill to compete with Ricotte for 1st place, this young lady is from Alpenbul's distinguished Bonifaz family. She is good friends with Ricotte, even though they are rivals.
translation: As the only songstress in the Roquefort company with enough skill to compete with Ricotte for 1st place, this young lady is from Alpenbul's distinguished Bonifaz family. She is good friends with Ricotte, even though they are rivals.
